title: Apple nears deal to pay Google $1B annually to power new Siri, report says
summary: Apple is turning to Google's technology to help revamp Siri and power a slate of upcoming features for the voice assistant.

title: Apple is planning to use a custom version of Google Gemini for Apple Intelligence
summary: Apple is preparing to power its AI-upgraded Siri with a custom version of Google’s Gemini AI model, according to a report from Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. The iPhone maker will reportedly pay Google around $1 billion annually to gain access to the technology, which will generate summaries and perform planning-related tasks.
